subject: Day 10: back-to-birth-weight check; cord stump may detach
bodyText:
Today's focus
Day 10. Most term infants reach or pass birth weight today through day 14. If the pediatrician has not yet confirmed weight regain, today is the day to call. The cord stump commonly detaches between today and day 15. The mother's bleeding (lochia serosa) is light pink-brown and tapering.

Action items
- If Avi has not been weighed since hospital discharge, call the pediatrician today. AAP Bright Futures periodicity schedule: https://www.aap.org/en/practice-management/bright-futures/bright-futures-tools-and-resources/
- Switch to tub baths once the cord stump has detached and the umbilical site looks dry. Sponge baths only until then. AAP HealthyChildren on bathing and skin care: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/bathing-skin-care/Pages/default.aspx
- If SSN has arrived, open the 529 plan this week. Front-loading the early years compounds maximally. 529 plan overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/529_plan
- Verify Avi is on health insurance (final reminder before the 30-day deadline ends). Healthcare.gov reference on QLEs: https://www.healthcare.gov/glossary/qualifying-life-event/
- Continue the feeding log; you will hand it to the pediatrician at the 1-month visit.

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Cord stump dries and detaches between days 5-15. A small spot of blood when it falls off is normal.
- [low concern] Mother's bleeding light pink-brown; baby acne peaking and beginning to resolve.
- [monitor] Cord still attached and looks wet or smells slightly off — pediatrician at next visit.
- [call within 24h] Pus, foul smell, or redness extending more than 1 cm around the cord (omphalitis is rare but emergent). Yellow tinge on legs or below. Weight not climbing or still below birth weight. Mother's bleeding suddenly heavier or large clots.
- [call now] Rectal temperature at or above 100.4F (38.0C). Lethargy, refusing all feeds, blue or grey color, breathing faster than 60 per minute at rest, persistent grunting, projectile or bilious-green vomiting. Call 911 for blue lips or unresponsiveness!

Enrichment opportunity
Mirror play during an awake-alert window: hold Avi in front of a mirror for 30-60 seconds. He is not recognizing himself yet, but face-perception circuitry is tuning. AAP HealthyChildren on early visual stimulation: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/default.aspx

Upcoming
- Day 5-15: cord stump detaches.
- Day 14-21: first common growth spurt; expect 24-48 hours of feeding-frequency uptick.
- Day 28-35: 1-month well visit window opens; first social smiles begin.

Further reading
- AAP HealthyChildren on bathing and skin care: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/bathing-skin-care/Pages/default.aspx
- AAP HealthyChildren overview of the first month: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/default.aspx
- Cribsheet by Emily Oster: https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/562146/cribsheet-by-emily-oster/
- 529 plan overview on Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/529_plan
